title: Split dev CI fastpath and dependency-stability adapter
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Developer feedback loops on redwood are noisy when dependency bumps or wide test matrices trigger slow CI runs. This PR splits the developer CI path into a 'dev-fastpath' profile that runs a narrow, deterministic set of checks for quick feedback and a 'dependency-stability' adapter that performs reproducible lockfile checks plus an expanded stability test matrix only when a dep bump is detected.

Goals and motivation: speed up presubmit feedback for iterative work, reduce flakes caused by transitive dependency churn, and centralize dependency acceptability logic into a reusable composite action for use across repos. Links: Linear ENG-9123 (dev-fastpath), ENG-9238 (dep-stability adapter). Related: SUP-2871 surfaced a support incident where a dep upgrade caused sporadic CI failures.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced .github/actions/dep-stability-adapter: a composite action that validates lockfile integrity, compares resolved transitive versions, and emits structured warnings + a small summary artifact. The action supports policy hooks (allowlist/blocklist) and an opt-in experimental auto-approve flag for minor semantic bumps.
- Added ci/profiles/dev_fastpath.yaml and updated .github/workflows/presubmit.yml to select the fastpath profile for most branches; the stability adapter is triggered on changes to lockfiles, package manifests, or when the PR title contains `[deps]`.
- Modified tools/ci/runner.py to accept --profile and respect a lightweight test-selector that prefers unit tests and deterministic integration slices. This reduces warmup time for ephemeral CI workers.
- Added scripts/lock-verify.sh and a python lockfile comparator tools/ci/lock_compare.py used by the composite action.
- Updated docs/ci-presubmit.md and contributors/ci-onboarding.md with examples for the new fastpath and stability lanes.

Checklist: [x] Add composite action and workflow wiring; [x] Update runner and selectors; [x] Docs & onboarding; [x] Add unit tests for lock_compare; [x] Run full internal CI and address flakes.

Small illustrative snippets included in the PR: the composite action exposes outputs 'stability_score' and 'warning_count' and logs a JSON summary artifact. The runner accepts '--profile dev_fastpath' and runs with TEST_SELECTOR=fastpath which resolves to a curated list of test globs.

Review conversation (high level):
- Miguel Santos (reviewer): "Nice separation. Please make the composite action idempotent and ensure artifacts are uploaded even on failures — we depend on the JSON summary in downstream tooling."
- Author (Asha): "Added explicit artifact upload in entrypoint.sh and a retry loop for transient network errors; left a TODO for integrating S3 retention policy."
- Jin Wei (reviewer): "The cache key change seems risky for Windows runners; can we make it path-aware and platform-agnostic?"
- Author: "Adjusted cache key to include os matrix and normalized path; added unit tests for cache key derivation."
- Priya Nair (approver): "Approvals pending flakiness fixes in test_fastpath_selection.py — after the internal rerun looks green, happy to approve."
- CI rerun: internal nightly flagged two flakey tests; author trimmed test scope and added deterministic seeding. Priya approved and requested squash on merge message.

CI summary: build: pass; unit-tests-fastpath: pass; lint: pass; lock-verify (dep-stability): pass; e2e-nightly: skipped for fastpath; security-scan: pass (no new vulnerabilities flagged). Total CI runtime for fastpath lane reduced from ~22m to ~6m on average in internal runs.

Risk and rollout plan: The change is backwards compatible. Default behavior for mainline branches remains the same for protected branches; the dev-fastpath is opt-in for feature branches (via branch naming) and automatically selected for most PRs. The dep-stability adapter runs when lockfiles change or PRs tagged with `[deps]`. We will roll this out to other repos in the org by copying the composite action and setting the presubmit selector.

Release notes: Implement dev-fastpath presubmit profile for faster feedback loops; add dep-stability composite action to gate dependency bumps and validate lockfile integrity. Admins: follow docs/ci-presubmit.md for adoption steps.

Merge: Squashed and merged to main 2026-02-28 by Asha Patel.

Additional context: This PR intentionally keeps the fastpath profile minimal — a follow-up will broaden the deterministic integration slices and expose a 'stability-scan' scheduled job for weekly dependency health metrics.
